messages:
Yusuf: Ok team — GlacierBank asked for a short POC readout tomorrow. Can we align on what metrics we want to show and who speaks to which topic?
Maria: I can cover latency/cost tradeoffs and the Dedicated vs Hosted recommendation. Planning to show 95th and p99 latencies.
Ethan: I'll take the prompt suite + evals. Quick note: their main use case is doc ingestion + multi-turn Q&A, so we should include KV cache hit rate and context window behavior.
Sophia: I'll handle security/SSO and the questionnaire gaps. They asked specifically about KMS integration and audit logs. I have the Qs they flagged.
Yusuf: Good. Also need a clear success criteria slide — what counts as a win for them? Maria/Ethan, can you propose 2–3 measurable pass/fail items?
Maria: Proposed success criteria: 1) average generation latency < 400ms for 1k-token sessions on Dedicated, 2) 95% of queries return within SLA (800ms), 3) end-to-end cost per 1k tokens <= $X (estimate). Thoughts?
Ethan: Add qualitative: retrieval accuracy on top-5 sources >= 88% and zero obvious hallucinations on sampled prompts. I'll run a 200-case prompt eval and produce a small confusion table.
Sophia: From compliance side we need: KMS OK, customer-managed VPC? Yes for Private. Also need a signed subprocessor list and SOC2 excerpt. They flagged data residency in EU. I'll confirm which regions we can serve.
Yusuf: Pricing question from procurement: is a short-term Dedicated trial discount possible? They're worried about commit levels. I suggested a 3-month pilot at 50% off the first month. Finance needs numbers.
Maria: I can show unit economics slide with quantization + batching options to hit their cost target. Will include our Optimize recommendations.
Ethan: Quick status on evals: running the 200 prompts now. Preliminary: model variant redwood-3-small quantized seems fine for recall but worse on long-coherence. I'll include a short demo comparing redwood-3-small vs redwood-3-medium on a 1.5k token context.
deploy-bot: Deployment finished for glacierbank-poc-dedicated in eu-west-1 (job id: job-8342).
Sophia: @deploy-bot perfect — confirms region. Yusuf, can we confirm who will run the Q&A on security at the call? I can answer KMS/VPC/audit questions but prefer someone from SolutionsEng for runtime failover details.
Yusuf: @Sophia I'll have Ethan cover runtime failover + fallback model policy, Maria cover ops and cost, Sophia security, and I'll handle commercial + next steps.
Maria: Slide checklist: - Architecture diagram (hosted vs dedicated) - Latency/cost metrics - Batching/quantization levers - Demo script and runbook - Rollout/scale ops plan - Commercial ask (pilot terms)
Ethan: Demo script: 1) ingest sample ledger + search, 2) multi-turn Q&A retrieving references, 3) failover test by throttling primary model to trigger fallback. Code snippet for ingestion:
```
POST /v1/ingest
{ "source": "glacier_ledger.csv", "embed_model": "redwood-emb-1" }
```
Include expected metrics: ingestion throughput ~ 500 rows/sec in Dedicated.
Sophia: For the security slide I'll note the outstanding items: signed subprocessor, EU data residency confirmation, and a tailored NDA clause on retention. I'll attach the QSA answers they requested.
Yusuf: Timeline for deliverables before the readout (tomorrow 11am): Maria — slides by 8pm tonight, Ethan — eval results + demo script by 9pm, Sophia — security packet by 9pm. Can everyone confirm?
Maria: Confirmed.
Ethan: Confirmed, running final eval sweep now.
Sophia: Confirmed, prepping the packet.
Yusuf: One more ask from their CTO — can we provide a short appendix showing fallback latency when converting to a smaller quantized model under load? Maria/Ethan, can we add that?
Maria: Yes, I'll add fallback latency curves and explain the tradeoffs.
Ethan: I'll include the actual numbers and the prompt sets used.
deploy-bot: Scheduled canary for glacierbank-poc will run at 10:30am UTC.
Yusuf: Great. If anything blocks, ping here. We'll do a 30-minute dry run at 10:00 UTC.
Sophia: Quick note — security wants a signed SOC2 excerpt before the call for procurement. I can send it from our repository, but need legal signoff to share. Looping in legal separately. :spiral_note_pad:
